'''Ruby''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[zardimallo]] that was considered highly valuable shortly after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. She was [[Thief|stolen]] by the [[Rhokai gang]] due to the [[lizard]]'s value, before the [[Devaronian]] criminal [[Roland Durand]] hired [[information broker]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback|Cid]] to deliver her to him. In turn, Cid dispatched the unit of former [[clone commando]]s known as the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]] to steal Ruby from the Rhokai. During the [[theft of Ruby]], the young [[Cloning|clone]] [[Omega]] gave her the name Ruby which Durand retained after he took ownership of her.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Ruby doesn't take a liking to many people.|Roland Durand|<ref name="Infested" />}}
Ruby was a [[Gender|female]] [[lizard]]<ref name="Battle Scars Guide">{{SW|url=battle-scars-episode-gallery|text="Battle Scars" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 1}}</ref> of the rare [[zardimallo]] [[species]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> that was considered valuable during the early [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Battle Scars Guide" /> The [[Devaronian]] criminal [[Roland Durand]],<ref name="Infested" /> a client of the [[Trandoshan]] [[information broker]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback|Cid]], wished to acquire Ruby and paid Cid to procure and deliver the lizard to him. Cid dispatched the [[Cloning|clones]] of [[Clone Force 99]] ("The Bad Batch") to steal Ruby from the [[Rhokai gang]], who had previously stolen her. The Rhokai pursued the clones' [[starship]], [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']], through [[Realspace|space]], but the [[clone commando]]s were able to escape into [[hyperspace]] with Ruby and deliver her to Cid.<ref name="Battle Scars" /> Ruby was provided to Durand, who kept her as a pet and retained Ruby as her name.<ref name="Infested" />

Durand later ousted Cid from her [[Cid's Parlor|parlor]] and took control of the establishment, bringing Ruby with him. Cid's regular patrons [[Bolo]] and [[Ketch]] kidnapped Ruby to lure Durand and his henchman from Cid's parlor so Cid and the Bad Batch could [[Theft on Ord Mantell|steal six crates]] of [[spice]] that Durand wanted to sell for the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. Durand loved Ruby and regularly pet her and rubbed her belly, so he threatened to [[Death|kill]] her kidnappers.<ref name="Infested" />

Later, Cid and the Bad Batch returned to Cid's Parlor, believing the [[Pyke]]s would have neutralized Durand by the time they arrived. While they were mostly correct, Durand informed the Pykes that the clones and Cid were the ones who actually stole the spice, so the Pykes took the [[Youngling|child]] clone [[Omega]] hostage and sent Cid and the other clones to retrieve the spice they'd stolen. While imprisoned next to Durand, Omega bonded with the Devaronian over Ruby's affection for both of them.<ref name="Infested" />

Even though Durand double-crossed the Bad Batch and Cid, Omega stuck up for the Devaronian because Ruby liked him, which Omega thought meant that Durand was not "all bad."<ref name="Infested" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ruby first appeared in the episode "[[Battle Scars]]" of the [[Disney+]] original web television show ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''.<ref name="Battle Scars" /> The episode became available to stream on [[June 11]], [[2021]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-june-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in June 2021|nolive=1}}</ref>
